title: Hotfix 2.4.1
body:
# Hotfix 2.4.1

Raiders, a hotfix is deploying right now to fix a handful of problems. Restart your game to grab the download.

* The bug letting players reach the Seed Vault extract while it was still shut has been corrected.

* The issue that could turn players invisible after leaving the Ballistic Gondola has been resolved.

* Multiple cases of invisible collision inside residential buildings have been fixed.

* Several crash problems affecting Xbox have been addressed.

This update also adds Ukrainian as a newly supported language. Thanks for all the reports so far, and please keep sending them in. See you Topside.
